title: Choose the best installed browser voice
acceptance: The browser voice adapter prefers a natural, same-language voice and falls back to the default; the choice is a pure function of getVoices() and is unit-tested.
The embed and /live speak with the chosen voice; RDR-008 records the audible difference on at least one Edge or Safari device.
No new network, key or dependency.

evidence.note: The score, speech and service roadmap; Record.
chooseVoice in the live voice adapter; LiveHost passes it; __riseLive.voice() under ?measure=1.
